description: This file defines a React functional component 'UIThemeSettings' that manages theme customization, specifically allowing users to update a logo URL for a dashboard UI. It handles fetching current settings, previewing the logo, updating settings via API calls, and resetting to defaults.

methods.name: fetchLogoSettings
methods.description: Fetches current logo URL settings from backend and updates state.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the new logo URL to backend, updates UI, and shows success/error notifications.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets the logo URL to default, updates backend, and shows notifications.
